headline: Prabowo promises low-interest credit without down payment for electric motorcycles
summary: President Prabowo Subianto promised a scheme of low-interest credit with no down payment to support purchases of electric motorcycles. The programme is intended to encourage electric two-wheeler adoption.
why: Electric two-wheeler subsidies and financing affect demand for electric vehicles and battery supply chains in Southeast Asia's large motorcycle market.
